finding: Organic reach, not creative polish, is the binding constraint: posting 2.5 times as often (20 to 50 a week) did not double organic exposure, and interactions per post fell from about 4 to about 1. Borrowed audiences (comments on bigger accounts, swaps, Notes conversations) come before more cross-posts.

evidence.result: 139 Buffer posts 5 Oct to 14 Nov: organic median exposure Facebook 2, Notes 4, Threads 5, X 7, YouTube 13, Instagram 58, TikTok 280; week of 9 Nov 50 posts, 3,696 organic exposures, 64 interactions.

revisit_when: After the 16 to 22 Nov comment campaign and swaps: compare organic exposure and new subscribers per week with the week of 9 Nov.
